geometry_source: raw FIONA 2022 outlines (114345 parcels, whole bbox)
wind: raw ERA5-Land hourly zips are not in data/raw/
notes: SEs clustered by parcel; season fixed effects absorb the season mean.
slope_pct only with the raw NASADEM; the K*S erosion factor is always included.
is_downwind needs u10/v10 in the ERA5-Land hourly download.
canopy windows need >= 2 clear pictures (June ((6, 1), (6, 25)), late summer ((8, 15), (9, 15))).

distances use the declared FIONA crops where the season and the one before are both declared (2023-2025, targets must be declared beet); in 2020-2022 the nearest wheat is known inside the demo blocks only, so those distances run against the cap.
coef_declared_years repeats the fit on the declared seasons only.
